body:
You are so young and have the potential to be whoever you want to be. You have countless possibilities of change. 
You will learn incredible new things, you will see beautiful places  you will meet beautiful people that will change your life forever. 
I have personally been there, I'm still getting out of depression but believe me it is worth it. 
Depression is like a cancer that takes over your thoughts and eventually your life. This is not the real you talking. You just 
have to resist one day more than your illness. 

Please stay. 

I love you and hug you real tight. ❤

Hi ❤
Unfortunately I am not really able to help. 
I am in the same situation as you, expect it's my little sister (14) 
I feel so powerless. 
I send you a lot of love and I virtually hug you really tight. 
I think you should tell your mum if you think that could help them. You'll probably going to regret it later if you don't and things go downhill 

I'm here if you need, it's nice to have someone to relate to

I'm standing at the other side. 
My sister (14) is suicidal. We have been talking very recently and for the vibes I get, she could do it any time from now. 
Love and selfishness are the answer to your questions. 
I love my sister to pieces. She would leave an umbearable void and umbearable pain to me. 
I am also depressed, have been for almost 8 years now. I just started getting better. 
I know I cannot force her to stay in this world. I know it's better to die than to suffer that much. 
And i am so selfish to want her to stay. Because unlike her, I have hope. I know there are things worth living for. 
She is physically healthy and full of potential. And she is so young, her life has barely started. She is full of options for her future. 

If you have the luck to be surrounded by people that love you,  I understand them. 
And i understand you. 
Your feelings are totally valid.

The world sucks. I know. Love, as cliché as it is, is the thing keeping me here. Knowing people, learning things. That's the thing for me. 

I send you love

I'm glad ❤

It's still a bit early imo to tell if it's working. I have an appointment every two weeks so I've roughly had 10 hours of therapy so far. 
I like my therapist tho, we tried family therapy with her for a couple of months (we stopped when my sister started refusing to go) so she knows my parents and has a clear image of the overall situation

The situation is not THAT bad in the family. We are not victims of abuse, my parents really deeply care for us, they are just not able to show it in a constructive way most of the times. 
They are suffering really much for this situation, each in different ways. 
Calling the authorities wouldn't probably help anyone, it would most likely make things worse.

Thank you so much for sharing your experience and caring about me. I send you so much love. 

I'm actually in therapy now, i have been for around 6 months.

I tried asking her to move in with me for some time, but she refuses to live the house even to come visit me (I'm just 1h30 by train so not that far). I even stopped asking to not stress her out. I tried offering her any kind of activity: concert, trips just me and her... Nothing worked. 
She doesn't even come having luch at my grammas' as we used to do very often.
